check_text:
protocol.py: 1 biology problem (1 error).

1. ERROR CONTAM-STOCK: A used tip went into a stock: 47 stocks
   line 75:  p300.aspirate(vol, src)
   At line 75 the tip went into serum 2 (well A2 in slot 2), serum 3 (well A3 in slot 2),
   serum 4 (well A4 in slot 2), serum 5 (well A5 in slot 2) and 43 more while it still
   carried serum 1 (well A1 in slot 2), serum 2 (well A2 in slot 2), serum 3 (well A3 in
   slot 2), serum 4 (well A4 in slot 2) and 43 more from an earlier step (this line did it
   47 times). A tip that has touched one liquid leaves a little of it in the next liquid it
   touches, so these stocks now hold material that does not belong there. Liquid drawn from
   them then took the unwanted material along into 44 other wells: wells A2, A3, A4, A5, A6,
   A7, A8, A9 and 36 more in slot 1.
   Affected: wells A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8, A9 and 31 more in slot 2; tubes A1, A2, B1,
   B2, C1, C2, D1 and D2 in slot 3.
   Also reached 44 other wells: wells A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8, A9 and 36 more in slot 1.
   Fix: Pick up a fresh tip before line 75 goes into the stock. Or change the order: hand
   out the shared liquid first, while the tip is still clean, and add the other liquids
   afterwards with a fresh tip each.
   Source: Lab Manager: minimizing cross-contamination in automated liquid handling
           https://www.labmanager.com/minimizing-cross-contamination-in-automated-liquid-handling-workflows-35194
   Source: WHO: dos and don'ts for molecular testing
           https://www.who.int/teams/global-malaria-programme/case-management/diagnosis/nucleic-acid-amplification-based-diagnostics/dos-and-don-ts-for-molecular-testing
   [2ae65f98cf52]

The Opentrons simulator (8.8.2) passed this protocol with no error: it checks that the robot
can make the moves, not what they do to the liquids.
